reported.title: No hysteresis on fan threshold
reported.description: Fan turns OFF as soon as temp drops below 42.0 °C instead of holding ON until 38.0 °C, so it chatters around the single trip point rather than using the required 42/38 band.

reported.title: No rate limit on fan transitions
reported.description: The 2-transitions-per-5000 ms limit is not implemented; with no hysteresis the relay can toggle every 50 ms sample, far exceeding the allowed rate.

reported.title: Override release drops fan immediately
reported.description: When the override is released, the fan state is recomputed from temperature alone, so a fan forced ON by override can snap OFF instantly even if temperature is above the ON threshold, and the override does not respect the transition rate limit.

reported.title: LM35 scaling uses 5000 mV reference
reported.description: analogRead is converted with 5000 mV/1023, but the Uno's default ADC reference is ~5 V with 1024 steps; using 1023 and assuming exactly 5000 mV biases the temperature reading, and the LM35 should be scaled as raw*5000/1024/10.

truth.description: Single 42 C trip point chatters under sensor noise

truth_for_judge.description: Single 42 C trip point chatters under sensor noise

exposing_checks.behaviour: D8 must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window (Fan switching limit)

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 temperature probe on A0 scaled at 10 mV/°C; ridge-vent relay on D8; override pushbutton on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Turn the vent fan ON when attic temperature reaches 42.0 °C or above, and turn it OFF when temperature falls to 38.0 °C or below.
- While D3 is held LOW, force the fan ON regardless of temperature.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Print one status line every 1000 ms in the form `attic: <temp> C fan=ON` or `attic: <temp> C fan=OFF` with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained threshold crossing.
